scope: 81 active exact colour surfaces; unresolved alternative-choice compatibility surfaces
objective: Capture exact colour compatibility only from reproducible exact-state configurator evidence.

static_pages_prove: the listed colours available for the observed default state
the current configurator exposes version, engine and colour selectors
static_pages_do_not_prove: the complete colour compatibility graph across every active grade/powertrain state
that a colour shown in one exact state remains available after changing grade or powertrain
the complete set of 81 target exact colour surfaces

execution_constraint: The available session tools can retrieve official configurator pages but cannot reproduce interactive selector changes and record each resulting exact state.
decision: Do not promote static colour lists into exact configuration observations. Preserve CAT-GAP-002 as blocked until reproducible exact-state interaction evidence is available.
excluded_actions: no inference from grade-level colour lists
no reopening of the closed Sandero Stepway full-modal evidence boundary
no changes to historical PR #634, #637 or #639
